meta.name: hyperframes-registry
meta.description: Install, discover, and wire registry blocks and components into HyperFrames compositions. Use when running hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, installing one item or every block matching a tag, wiring an installed item into index.html, or working with hyperframes.json. Covers discovery, install locations, block sub-composition wiring, component snippet merging, and authoring a new block or component to contribute upstream (idea → scaffold → validate → PR).

copy.tagline: 安装、发现和编排 HyperFrames 组件块
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在用 HyperFrames 构建组合式前端应用
copy.tagline_en: Install, discover, and wire HyperFrames registry blocks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build composable frontend apps with HyperFrames

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能执行 hyperframes add 安装 registry 中的块/组件，能运行 hyperframes catalog 发现可安装项，会把安装好的项接线进 index.html 的 composition，也能处理 hyperframes.json 配置。还可以按新块/组件的流程产出贡献 PR 的脚手架。
howto.when: 当你说要运行 hyperframes add/catalog、安装某个块或某 tag 下所有块、把已安装项接入 index.html，或操作 hyperframes.json 时触发。

say.text: 帮我安装 data-chart 这个 block
列出所有 type 为 component 的目录
把 grain-overlay 组件接到 index.html 里

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can run `hyperframes add` to install registry blocks/components, run `hyperframes catalog` to discover items, wire installed items into `index.html` compositions, and handle `hyperframes.json` configs. It can also scaffold new blocks/components for upstream PRs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to run `hyperframes add`/`catalog`, install a specific block or all blocks matching a tag, wire an installed item into `index.html`, or work with `hyperframes.json`.

say_en.text: Install the data-chart block for me.
say_en.note: Runs `hyperframes add data-chart` and shows the wiring snippet.

say_en.text: List all components in the catalog.
Wire the grain-overlay component into index.html.
say_en.note: Merges the component snippet into your composition.
